titles.romaji: NEW GAME!: Watashi, Shainryokoutte Hajimete na no de...
titles.native: NEW GAME! 私、社員旅行って初めてなので…

description: The staff of Eagle Jump take a long awaited vacation to a ski resort, celebrating the release of their latest iteration of the 'Fairies Story' game. Being her first company trip, Aoba Suzukaze is excited for it, but is also apprehensive as she has no prior skiing experience. Join Aoba and her colleagues as they de-stress and enjoy their time at the resort.
